phase: initial (frozen, written before any command was executed)
overall_reason: The update changes three requirement-bearing mechanisms that the old suite observes: (1) auto-leave in raft.advance becomes edge-triggered, bumps pendingConfIndex to the leave entry, uses nil Data (weight 0) and panics instead of the DropQuota retry; (2) leader proposal admission now also rewrites conf changes to empty normal entries when joint && !leave or !joint && leave, and the uncommitted-size quota never refuses zero-size entries; (3) switchToConfig aborts a leadership transfer when the transferee is demoted (not only removed). Old AutoLeaveAdvance encodes the old duplicate-leave bug (it REQUIRES a leave at every Advance with cursor>=pendingConf) and a DropQuota retry branch that is now forbidden, so it must be modified with an observer migration. ProposalContract/OutcomeSoundness must gain the joint admission rule and the s>0 quota relaxation. A new transfer-target invariant is required for the demotion abort. All other properties are kept; Next=LastIndex initialisation, nil-Data auto-leave weight, probe-on-config-change, sorted vote order, reorder of reduceUncommittedSize are model/representation changes that do not alter any property text.

suspected_defects_not_to_hide.description: New leader elected while applied==lastIndex in a joint AutoLeave config never auto-leaves: advance requires oldApplied < pendingConfIndex but becomeLeader sets pendingConfIndex=lastIndex==applied (raft.go:567,752).

Node.Advance before ApplyConfChange (allowed by node.go:164-167): (a) advancing over the joint entry before it is applied misses the auto-leave forever; (b) advancing over the leave entry before it is applied appends a duplicate leave which later fails 'can't leave a non-joint config' and panics.

Admission classifies wantsLeaveJoint by len(Changes)==0, so a ConfChangeV2 with no changes but Transition JointExplicit/JointImplicit is admitted while joint; applyConfChange then calls EnterJoint on a joint config and panics.

Model drift (not a property issue): base!AdvanceCore, RewriteConf, AppendQuotaExceeded, ChangeProgress, ApplyConfCore, Restore, AutoLeaveWeight still describe the old code and must be migrated in the model; self Match after restore becomes s.index-1 in new code (raft.go:1482-1483 with Next=LastIndex).
